A bill for an act relating to public safety; appropriating money for a state program fraud tip line public relations campaign.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+PUBLIC AWARENESS CAMPAIGN; STATE PROGRAM FRAUD TIP LINE. +]

[+$....... is appropriated in fiscal year 2027 from the general fund to the commissioner of public safety for a public awareness campaign to increase awareness of: (1) the Bureau of Criminal Apprehension's state program fraud tip line; and (2) whistleblower procedures and rights regarding the reporting of fraud against programs funded or administered by the state. The commissioner may contract with a private entity for the public awareness campaign. This is a onetime appropriation. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to public safety; appropriating money for a state program fraud tip line public relations campaign.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. PUBLIC AWARENESS CAMPAIGN; STATE PROGRAM FRAUD TIP LINE.

$....... is appropriated in fiscal year 2027 from the general fund to the commissioner of public safety for a public awareness campaign to increase awareness of: (1) the Bureau of Criminal Apprehension's state program fraud tip line; and (2) whistleblower procedures and rights regarding the reporting of fraud against programs funded or administered by the state. The commissioner may contract with a private entity for the public awareness campaign. This is a onetime appropriation.
